name: PatientNotes
description: PatientNotes is positioned as the most affordable AI medical scribe at $50/user/month with annual billing ($70/mo monthly). Unlimited patient visits included—no credit caps like competitors. 37 specialty templates supported. 7-day free trial with no credit card required, plus 14-day money-back guarantee on paid plans. HIPAA compliant with BAA for all paid customers. Key differentiator: strongest value pick for solo and small clinics who need specialty templates at a budget price. Patient data never used for AI training. All data stored in HIPAA-compliant US data centers with AES-256 encryption.

faqs.q: Is PatientNotes good for mental health practices?
faqs.a: Not specifically. PatientNotes is designed for general medical documentation with 37 specialty templates. Mental health therapists should use Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) or Upheal ($69/mo). Psychiatrists should consider DeepCura ($129/mo) or Freed ($39-119/mo).

faqs.q: PatientNotes vs Freed: which is better?
faqs.a: PatientNotes ($50-70/mo) is the most affordable option with unlimited visits. Freed ($39-119/mo starting) offers more features and specialty support but at higher price points for full features. For budget-first practices, PatientNotes. For more comprehensive features, Freed.
